title: The Quarantine Translation Rupture
logline: A quarantine marshal and an isolated monastic brewery interpret an anomalous spectral reading in opposite ways, threatening an accidental military bombardment of innocent monks.

roles.description: Port health officer enforcing the quarantine boundary; sleep-deprived, rigid, haunted by memories of an unchecked outbreak.
Head of an orbital monastery and brewery; defensive, austere, convinced health inspectors are agents sent to steal sacred fermenting yeast.
An ancient hollowed-asteroid monastery cultivating yeast for liturgical beer and medicine.
The fortified health inspection platform commanding the orbital cordon.

public_situation: A quarantine cordon surrounds {role:hermitage_station} while patrol vessels prepare sterilization batteries to cleanse an alleged viral outbreak.
private_truth: The diagnostic spectrometer is misinterpreting volatile aromas from an exotic sacramental yeast batch as an airborne pathogen.

beats.public_change: Flashing quarantine buoys deploy along the outer approach vectors to {role:hermitage_station}, barring all uncertified civilian vessels.

missions.reason: She hires an uninfected pilot to mine and deliver pure water ice to replenish coolant tanks on the sterilization artillery platform.
missions.private_fact: She lost her entire family to a respiratory blight five years ago and refuses to allow even a single doubtful diagnostic reading to pass.

beats.public_change: The monastery abbot transmits encrypted scripture verses on medical frequencies, defying orders to vent his habitat's fermentation cellars.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the habitat's exhaust vents to prove the chemical emissions match ancient fermentation steam rather than spores.
missions.private_fact: His monks secretly stole the foundational yeast strain from a corporate pharmaceutical laboratory four generations ago.

beats.public_change: Targeting lasers from {role:quarantine_outpost} lock onto the monastery's central airlocks as the sterilization countdown reaches its final hour.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier an uncorrupted physical vial of the brewing culture to the marshal's laboratory before the bombardment begins.
missions.private_fact: He would rather watch the asteroid monastery vaporized than let a secular inspector seize the monastic breeding notes.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the quarantine post holding the live monastery brewing yeast as targeting computers align for bombardment.

options.label: Run the biological assay to prove the culture is harmless yeast and abort the strike
Flee the post and sell the priceless ancient yeast strain to an offshore luxury brewer
Confirm the pathogen report to allow the marshal to sterilize the contaminated site

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the culture vial and verifies its harmless organic nature.
resolutions.summary: The test proves the emission is benign brewing yeast. {role:quarantine_marshal} cancels the bombardment and lifts the cordon from {role:hermitage_station}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot showed health inspectors that an asteroid's deadly viral outbreak was just monks brewing sacred beer.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot steals the sample vial and sells the heritage yeast to commercial interests.
resolutions.summary: The pilot vanishes with the yeast. Deprived of physical evidence, {role:quarantine_marshal} forces the evacuation of {role:hermitage_station}.

resolutions.reached_by: The culture is condemned or the verification fails before the deadline strikes.
resolutions.summary: Targeting guns bombard {role:hermitage_station}. The monastery's heritage yeast is incinerated, and the surviving monks are dispersed as destitute vagrants.

loose_threads.detail: The quarantine station's sensor firmware was updated three weeks ago by a technician who was later discharged for forging calibration tags.
The sacramental yeast culture flask bears an etched pharmaceutical patent symbol identical to a corporate patent held by an inner-system firm.

radio_hooks: Quarantine command warns approaching freighters that hermitage airspace is declared hot.
Station chaplains issue urgent radio appeals calling for calm across the quarantined sector.
Thermal sensor data from asteroid monastery leaks onto commercial trading feeds.

voice_direction.quarantine_marshal: Haggard, intense, and clipped. Speaks in dry clinical jargon and repeats decontamination procedures like nervous tics.
voice_direction.station_abbot: Dignified, slow, and steeped in ritual cadence. Treats secular authority with mild, quiet pity and speaks of yeast like living martyrs.
